Knowledge facts: part C holds 46 fact blocks (sec08-F01 onward) from physical pages 59 to 69; part C2 holds 50 confusable and continuation blocks (sec08-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states the issuer, the July 1, 2022 content date, the multiple-choice format and its four roughly equal topic areas, the vision standard and the one-day retake wait from physical pages 3, 35 and 36; question count, passing score and time limit are unknown.
VERIFY list:
- TN-ROAD1-A-EXAM — question count, passing score and time limit not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- TN-ROAD1-A-FRESH — content dated July 1, 2022; current edition and liveness unconfirmed (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- TN-ROAD1-D-STOPPOINT — stop-sign position with no markings: point with a view of cross traffic versus even with the sign (owner HallucinationAuditor).
- TN-ROADONE-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- TN-ROADONE-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: speed limits, school bus and work zone fines, the littering fines, the crash statistics and the Move Over Law details (for example sec08-F11, sec08-F14, sec08-F34, sec08-F46, sec08-R07, sec08-R17) can change and must be refreshed from official Tennessee sources.
